$comment: Build pieces. Engine fields (key, footprint, levels, layer 0 deck/1 structure/2 furniture/3 decor, solid, cost, sockets in 1/4 tiles, hp) are validated by @engine/world loadBuildPieces; ids from ids.lock.json. Gameplay fields: placement cell|edge|opening|free, tiered (cost/hp from tiers.json x costScale; hp = base hp at wood tier), z rules, support flags, station/heat/fuel/container/privilege. Socket kinds: 1 edge, 2 door, 3 window, 4 hatch. Art: manifest key = sprite or key; Art & Assets owns all visuals. fuelMul: heat sources burn each fuel item fuelMul x its fuelSeconds (fireplace/wood_stove are efficient). features.windsock: reads core Weather wind via windsockReading (no extra state).

pieces.$variants: 0 plain, 1 wall_clan_wood, 2 wall_clan_stone, 3 wall_clan_palisade (art only; stats per material tier)

pieces.$shape: ADR-211: an L corner wall. Two full-length arms claim both outer edges of the foundation corner it wraps (cost = two walls).
